decisions.reason: The reporting specification uses contacts and notes that no Leads Table exists, but it does not change the requirement to create or manage HubSpot lead lists.
Grouping and funnel-reporting rules do not alter the HubSpot task-assignment behavior.
The source specifies report grouping, stage counts, and conversion, without changing visibility of email or LinkedIn communication history.
The report consumes Contact Source and lead-stage data but does not change the existing lead-classification mechanisms or define new stage values.
The reporting requirements do not mention or alter lead-note behavior.
The requested funnel report does not change lead-nurturing workflows or automation.
The source requests aggregate stage reporting and does not change how MeetAlfred activity maps to HubSpot Lead Status.
The reporting specification does not modify the direction, object, method, or behavior of HubSpot-to-MeetAlfred synchronization.
Using HubSpot contacts as reporting data does not change Apollo enrichment data, provider, target, or mode.
The requested report operates on CRM records but does not change the LinkedIn-to-HubSpot transfer path or transfer behavior.
The reporting dimensions and metrics do not alter which LinkedIn or Sales Navigator URLs must be stored in CRM records.
Although Contact Source represents campaign names, the report-grouping decision does not change how new MeetAlfred campaigns or their Zaps are created.
